title: Explain Your Adding and Subtracting Within 100
description: Explain addition and subtraction within 100 using tens, ones, base-ten models, and short sentence starters.
learningFocus: Explain how to add and subtract two-digit numbers within 100 by working with tens and ones, without regrouping.
adultGuidance: Read each sentence starter aloud and ask your child to point to the matching tens and ones before completing it. Encourage them to explain the method in their own words, then compare their explanation with the choices; clear place-value reasoning matters more than using a perfect sentence.
